name: multi_kind_lex_sort
description: Three action_kinds with overlapping prefixes (envelope.deliver and envelope.send share 'envelope.') that exercise the lex-ascending UTF-8 byte sort. agent.register sorts before both envelope.* kinds because 'a' (0x61) < 'e' (0x65). Within the envelope.* prefix, '.deliver' (0x2e64) sorts before '.send' (0x2e73). batch_root is the sequence 0x01..0x20 (32 distinct bytes) for visual byte-position debugging.
